data.name: Aram
data.gender_notes: Aram is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Aram is derived from the Arabic word 'arama', which means 'to be high, noble, or exalted'. It is a name that is rich in meaning and symbolism in Islamic culture. The name Aram carries the meaning “High, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aram usually hope their child will grow to embody high, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies one's connection to the divine and striving for excellence in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Aram belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “High, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aram total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أرام
in_arabic.long_meaning: أرام هو اسم يعني الهدوء والسكينة والراحة النفسية، وهو مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ر-و-م' الذي يدل على الهدوء والاستقرار. وقد ورد هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر آية 47: 'وَأَرسَلنَا الرِّياحَ لَطِيفًا مُّبَشِّرًا وَأَنزَلنَا مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً لَّطِيفًا لِّنُحْيِيَ بِهِ أَرضًا مَيتًا وَنُسقِيَها مِمَّا خَلَقنَا أَدْنَيا وَبَهلًا وَجِنانًا ذَاتَ أُكُلٍ أَخضَرًا'

in_urdu.name: ارام
in_urdu.long_meaning: ارام ایک ایسا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے سکون، ذہنی راحت اور آرام دہندگی۔ یہ نام عربی جذر 'ر-و-م' سے ماخوذ ہے جو سکون اور استقرار کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے ثقافتی سیاق میں، یہ نام روحانی سکون اور اندرونی امن کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आराम
in_hindi.long_meaning: आराम एक ऐसा नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सुकून, मानसिक शांति और आरामदायकता। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'र-व-म' से लिया गया है, जो शांति और स्थिरता की ओर इशारा करता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक शांति और आंतरिक शांति के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: ارام
in_pashto.long_meaning: ارام دى يو نوم چې مانى يې دى سکون، ذهني راحت او آرام. دا نوم د عربي ريښې 'ر-و-م' څخه اخستل شوى دى، کوم چې د سکون او استقرار دلالت کوي. د افغان او پښتون دوديز په سياق کې، دا نوم د روحاني سکون او inner peace نښه ګڼل کيږي.

in_english.name: Aram
in_english.long_meaning: Aram is a name that signifies tranquility, calmness, and mental peace. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'ر-و-م' (r-w-m), which denotes stillness and stability. This root is referenced in the Quran, Surat Al-Hijr, Verse 47, emphasizing the concept of gentle breeze and rain for reviving barren land. Historically, the name Aram holds spiritual significance across Islamic traditions, symbolizing inner peace and serenity.

historical_references.reference: Aram was an ancient kingdom located in the northern part of the Fertile Crescent, modern-day Syria. It is believed to have existed from around 2000 BCE to 539 BCE. Aram was an important center of the Aramean civilization, which influenced the development of the Israeli and Arab civilizations.

historical_references.reference: The term 'Aram' was also used in the Islamic tradition to refer to a specific region in the northwestern part of the Arabian Peninsula, inhabited by the Arameans. This region was a significant trade center and was mentioned in various Islamic texts, including the Quran and Hadiths.
